pharma.title: CDSCO to launch digital drug regulatory platform
pharma.summary: The Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO) plans to launch the first phase of an end-to-end digital drug regulatory platform within 18 months. This initiative aims to digitize and streamline pharmaceutical regulatory processes across India.

pharma.title: Intas gets CDSCO nod for breast cancer drug Trastuzumab Emtansine
pharma.summary: Intas Pharmaceuticals has received regulatory approval from the CDSCO for Trastuzumab Emtansine, an antibody-drug conjugate used in breast cancer treatment.

pharma.title: Eisai launches Alzheimer's drug Leqembi in India
pharma.summary: Pharma company Eisai has launched its Alzheimer's disease treatment drug Leqembi in India following approval from the CDSCO.

pharma.title: CDSCO proposes ban on 'Same Brand, Different Drug' practice
pharma.summary: The CDSCO has proposed a ban on using identical brand names for formulations containing different active pharmaceutical ingredients to prevent confusion and protect patient safety.

pharma.title: NPPA caps prices of 39 new medicines amid calls for pricing review
pharma.summary: The National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority (NPPA) capped the prices of 39 new formulation drugs. Meanwhile, a parliamentary panel noted that roughly 82% of medicines sold in India remain outside direct price control.

national.title: India celebrates National Panchayati Raj Day
national.summary: India commemorated National Panchayati Raj Day to highlight and strengthen local self-governance across rural institutions.

national.title: Free trade agreements protect national interests, says Union Minister
national.summary: Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan stated that recent free trade agreements signed by India fully protect the nation's economic and strategic interests.

international.title: US-Canada trade talks falter
international.summary: Bilateral trade discussions between the United States and Canada hit severe roadblocks following disagreements over trade policies and economic terms.

international.title: Indian women's team competes in FIH Hockey World Cup
international.summary: The Indian women's national hockey team faced Australia in an international group-stage match at the FIH Hockey World Cup.

science.title: India and Japan sign quantum technology and healthcare agreements
science.summary: India and Japan signed bilateral cooperation agreements focusing on joint advancement in quantum technology and healthcare research.

science.title: THSTI hosts 3rd Industry Meet 'SYNCHN 2026'
science.summary: The Translational Health Science and Technology Institute hosted its 3rd industry engagement meeting titled 'SYNCHN 2026' to foster academia-industry collaboration.

science.title: Thermo Fisher Scientific showcases biopharma technologies in India
science.summary: Thermo Fisher Scientific presented next-generation technological solutions in India to support and expand the local biopharmaceutical innovation ecosystem.

important_days.title: International Youth Day - August 12
important_days.summary: International Youth Day is observed globally on August 12 to bring youth issues to the forefront of the international community.

important_days.title: International Day of Yoga - June 21
important_days.summary: International Day of Yoga is celebrated annually on June 21 to promote holistic health and well-being worldwide.

mcqs.q: Which pharmaceutical firm received CDSCO approval to launch the Alzheimer's drug Leqembi in India?
mcqs.explanation: Eisai officially launched its Alzheimer's disease treatment Leqembi in India following regulatory clearance from the CDSCO.

mcqs.q: What risk does the CDSCO aim to mitigate by proposing a ban on the 'Same Brand, Different Drug' practice?
options: Patient confusion and medication errors due to identical brand names for different APIs
High import tariffs on Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients
Delay in digital licensing for retail pharmacies
mcqs.explanation: CDSCO's proposal to ban 'Same Brand, Different Drug' aims to prevent mix-ups where distinct drug formulations are marketed under the same brand name.

mcqs.q: India recently signed bilateral cooperation agreements in quantum technology and healthcare with which country?
mcqs.explanation: India and Japan signed key agreements targeting institutional cooperation in healthcare and quantum technology.
